All three round-1 fixes hold up under direct inspection, not just inference from the clean failures list. First, the closing 'Choosing a model by team and release style' table: the Why column source is now five short phrases ('No release branch to maintain', 'hotfix patches main without develop', etc.) instead of full cited sentences, and on desktop all three columns (Situation/Fits/Why) sit comfortably inside the text column with room to spare -- on mobile the table still opens scrolled to Situation, as every table on the site does by design, but reaching Fits and Why is now a short swipe instead of the citation-laden sentences round 1 flagged, and every phrase that WAS checked is short enough to satisfy WRITER_GUIDE's phrase-not-sentence rule and its 40-character never-wraps guidance. Second, Figure 1's bottom box: the label is now two stacked d-small lines, 'release-0.2' / 'tagged, deleted', both fully inside the dashed box border in every screenshot checked (mobile/desktop x light/dark) -- the text no longer crosses the box edge in any theme. Third, the two git-log clips round 1 tied to specific prose references are both fixed at the source: the discounts commit is now the short 'feat: add discounts flag' (fully visible, unclipped, in the panel the prose later calls 'the flag, not the merge'), and the hotfix's row-count commit is now 'fix: correct row count' (fully visible, unclipped, in the panel the prose later calls 'the row-count fix'). One earlier minor issue remains open by design, not oversight: round 1's own fix note said panels with load-bearing clips were worth touching but 'not worth reworking every panel' otherwise, and that holds -- the 'chore: seed the production branch' line, for example, still clips to '...production bran' in the initial-seed panels, but nothing in the surrounding prose depends on reading that tail, matching the guidance to leave decorative clipping alone. The 'Related articles' card list also still surfaces only one of the two prerequisites, exactly as round 1 noted and explicitly said was fine to leave. A fresh full pass found nothing new: heading structure is a clean single-level hierarchy (8 h2 sections, no h3, no skipped levels, exactly one h1), all five exercises collapse their solutions by default with a consistent 'Show solution' affordance and correct per-article numbering, code/output/prose rhythm is steady across all three branching-model walkthroughs, and dark-mode retinting of all three diagrams (accent strokes, box fills, arrow markers) is correct everywhere checked. This clears the 8.5 pass bar; it is not a 10 only because the table's mobile-first-paint view still shows just one of three columns (an inherent, accepted property of the site's table component, not a defect introduced or left by this article) and because of the two long-standing, explicitly-accepted minor items above.
